entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The ruined homeworld of the Kav, a planet riven in two and crumbling into space near the supervoid Sothera.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: The people of Kavaron who mined their world to ruin and are evacuating to space stations.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: A supervoid in the Edge, near which Kavaron orbits; its impending supernova drove the Kav's mining.

entities.name: Kavaron Before
entities.description: The stable remaining wedge of Kavaron held by tectonic anchors, where the imperial capital Vu stands.

entities.name: Kavaron That Is
entities.description: The shattered half of Kavaron, a gravitational storm of debris with no official government.

entities.name: Vu
entities.description: The ancient capital of the Kavaronic Empire and last imperial city on the planet.

entities.name: Guns of Kavaron
entities.description: Boost lasers that push debris higher into orbit.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: A strike town for Kav miners destroyed in a nuclear blast.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company Palestar Sundog
entities.description: The ship and company that destroyed Taro-duend under Syr Vondam.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: The commander under whom Palestar Sundog destroyed Taro-duend.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Who decelerated a Ring strike that hit a Rushdown village.

entities.name: The Ruin
entities.description: The collapse of Kavaron after centuries of strip mining.

entities.name: Exodus Day
entities.description: The day the first Kav refugee shuttle left the surface.

events.summary: Driven by the coming supernova, the Kav's mining collapses Kavaron, which crumbles into space during the Ruin.
events.quote: The planet finally crumbled after centuries of Kav industrial strip mining

events.summary: On Exodus Day the first Kav shuttle lifts the first refugees off Kavaron.
events.quote: the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface

events.summary: A Ring strike decelerated by Tannuk hits a Rushdown village, killing most of its inhabitants.
The Palestar Sundog under Syr Vondam destroys Taro-duend, killing all 6,000 inhabitants and igniting its fusion engine in a nuclear blast.
events.quote: After killing all 6,000 inhabitants, the ship ignited its fusion engine, wiping out the remains in a nuclear blast.

relations.quote: It is the homeworld of the Kav
the second-closest planet to the supervoid Sothera in the Edge

relations.note: Commanded the ship in the attack.
relations.quote: the Sunstar Free Company Palestar Sundog under Syr Vondam

relations.note: The remaining whole side of the planet.
relations.quote: The Kav regard Kavaron as split into two hemispheres
